text:
Lena (People Ops): Thanks everyone for coming to today's all-hands — dropping answers and follow-ups here. Ask any questions about reviews / promotions / comp and we'll follow up.

Sam: Quick Q — when will promo decisions land? I thought timeline was end of month.

Lena (People Ops): We expect final decisions the week of Apr 4. Managers should have check-ins scheduled by next Wed. If you don't have one, ping me and I'll nudge your manager.

Alex: Is there any change to the bar for L4->L5 this cycle? Heard different things in team syncs.

Maya (Talent Partner): No change to the bar — we are not raising criteria. What we are doing is tightening the calibration guidance to reduce subjectivity (see slide 7). Managers: please document impact, scale, and candidate examples in packets.

Raj (Eng Manager): Calibration rubric — can we get concrete examples to share with our ICs? Engineers want artifacts, not just phrases.

Lena (People Ops): Yes — we'll post three anonymized example packets (strong / clear / borderline) by EOD Monday. Use those in your 1:1s.

Tina: @Lena if someone missed their manager check-in due to PTO, can they still be considered for promo? I was out two weeks.

Lena (People Ops): Yes. Managers can submit late packets with a short note explaining the situation. The priority is evidence of impact; missing a single 1:1 won't block consideration.

Mike (CEO): To add — consistency across teams matters a lot to us. If you think a decision is unfair, there's an appeals window (2 weeks after notices). People Ops will triage and escalate as needed.

Priya: Comp question — will market adjustments be handled centrally or per-person? I saw "market refresh" on the slides but not the details.

Maya (Talent Partner): Market refreshes are reviewed per person, not a single pooled top-up. We do have a limited budget this quarter, so we'll prioritize based on risk buckets (e.g., hires below midpoint, retention risks, critical roles). Managers will receive guidance on prioritization next week.

Andre (VP Eng): From Eng leadership: are promotion velocity targets changing? We're trying to set realistic expectations for managers and ICs.

Lena (People Ops): No velocity targets are changing for this cycle. Our focus is clearer feedback and signal in performance conversations, not pushing more promos than warranted.

people-ops-bot: Reminder — review toolkit and packet template: https://redwood.internal/docs/reviews (packet template v2 is the one to use).

Sam: Thanks — one more: how are stock refreshes handled for folks promoted mid-cycle?

Maya (Talent Partner): If the promotion completes before the grant-cycle cutoff, the person is eligible for a pro-rata refresh. Exact cutoff dates and examples will be in the toolkit doc we're updating.

Alex: Is there a preferred place to ask follow-ups privately?

Lena (People Ops): DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com for anything sensitive. For appeals, use appeals@redwood.com (code block for clarity):

```
appeals@redwood.com
people-ops@redwood.com
```

Sam: :thumbsup: thanks all.

Lena (People Ops): I'll upload the anonymized examples and an FAQ by Monday afternoon. If anything urgent, DM me and I'll prioritize.
